title: Aaron Jones aggravated his knee injury in Sunday's win

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Aaron Jones aggravated his knee injury in Sunday's win
sources.description: Vikings running back Aaron Jones was called questionable to return after going to get his knee checked out on Sunday and he did not return for the final minutes of Minnesota's 16-10 win over the Colts.
